title: Correct task-sync recovery commands and import wording that W45's round-3 review flagged
outcome: Correct task-sync recovery commands and import wording that W45's round-3 review flagged
acceptance: The saved-basis recovery command that a task-sync folder import refusal prints (src/task_sync/data_worktree.rs) keeps a non-default --branch, so an import started with --branch planning-data names that branch in its remedy

The inventory-root mismatch refusal an ordinary folder import reaches (VerifiedTaskDelta::require_root, src/task_sync/git/delta/verified.rs) names `--rebuild --basis OWN_EXPORT/project.json` with this host's saved export envelope, not a bare --rebuild that import refuses
docs/features/git-task-sync.md states that only the legacy Written route re-reads this host's exported tasks; an ordinary import adopts them through own-export confirmation
